rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price bounced on shrinking volume (109k→23k per 1m candle) into the 9-EMA at 33.60, tagged 33.61, and was rejected back down to 33.51 while staying well below VWAP (33.75) in a still risk-off tape, so no invalidation trigger has fired. However, midday volume decay and the fade off the 33.35 low lower the odds of a sustained flush to the 33.15 target, so conviction stays modest rather than high. Risk remains contained at the 33.80 invalidation (~$69) versus ~$86 of room to the original target.
